title: A clear strategy for growth — built around your objectives
intro:
KHR Consultants (SMC-Private) Limited is an Islamabad-based advisory company providing tax, audit and corporate services from freelancers and startups to established companies and not-for-profits, stay compliant and make confident financial decisions.

We started KHR because many business owners were being left to deal with FBR, SECP and provincial authorities alone, often finding out about problems only when a notice arrived. We do it differently: we explain things in plain language, tell you what’s needed and when, and handle the paperwork so you can focus on running your business.

Led by Ali Abbas, Co-Founder and CEO.
mission: To provide exceptional service to every client — through professional excellence, integrity and long-lasting relationships.
